inputs.hash_binding_note: bound to the canonical LF bytes that git stores; the working tree is CRLF on Windows, whose raw digest differs for identical content
inputs.code_commit_semantics: HEAD at run time; this artifact is committed in the next commit, so code_commit is that commit's parent

candidates.name: 季节 naive（去年同月）
candidates.description: forecast[m] = y[origin-11 .. origin] same month last year; <12 months falls back to mean3

candidates.name: 近 3 月均值
candidates.description: constant mean of the last 3 months; recent level, no seasonality

candidates.name: 季节 naive × 近期同比修正
candidates.description: seasonal naive x shrunk, clipped trailing-6m YoY factor; skipped on short/near-zero/zero-in-window baselines

candidates.name: AutoETS / ETS
candidates.description: explicitly skipped: statsmodels and statsforecast are not installed; V0's hand-rolled additive HW is not reused as a candidate

candidates.name: 同类季节形状 × 本 SKU 近期水平
candidates.description: median peer monthly/trailing-12m shape applied to own trailing-12m level; peers are the other 9 SKUs with >=12 months

ets_status.reason: statsmodels and statsforecast are not installed in the project environment

backtest.rule: last 6 origins 2026-01..2026-06 with known h=1..3; fit uses y<=origin; targets origin+1..+3; no future data in fit
backtest.metrics: WAPE, bias (sum(f-a)/sum(a)), P90 coverage; zero-actual cells retained; all-zero denominator -> WAPE/bias null; target 0.90 recorded separately

p90.method: rolling empirical / conformal-style quantile of rolling-origin cumulative errors (A_h - F_h); level ceil((n+1)*0.9)/n then np.quantile(method='higher')
p90.rank_note: the implemented level is one step MORE conservative than the exact k=ceil((n+1)*0.9) order statistic (n=20: max instead of the 19th); for n<9 k>n and the quantile clamps to the sample max, so no distribution-free 90% coverage follows
p90.pooled_fallback: estimate_pooled_peer_relative: (A-F)/F from other SKUs' primary cells when own n<3
p90.delegated_excluded: origins where the candidate delegates to another model (e.g. seasonal_yoy skipped) are excluded from its calibration
p90.floor: P90 >= P50; negative residual quantiles do not lower the P50

window_p90.window: calendar [decision, decision+days) with integer bucket days; asserted sum(bucket days) == requested_days
window_p90.calibration: same-shape historical calendar windows: decision = the 22nd of the origin+1 month, identical bucket weights, residuals A_window - F_window
window_p90.label_availability: the actual uses monthly shipped totals, so a residual enters a calibration point only when its last month has closed: label_available_at (first day of the next month) <= asof. Filtering on window_end alone would consume a month total before it existed (R3-Major1).
window_p90.forbidden: a full-month cumulative residual (h = round(days/30.4375)) may NOT stand in for a partial-month window P90

seasonal_yoy.window: trailing 6 months vs same 6 months last year

peer_shape.peers: the other 9 SKUs, truncated at the same origin
peer_shape.own_level: trailing 12 months, or all history if <12 months
peer_shape.shape: median of y[m]/trailing12_mean by calendar month

aggregate.note: sums across SKUs are scenario totals, not a purchase/production order; P90 is per-SKU upper bound, not a portfolio P90; window coverage is a rolling-origin, overlap-correlated estimate on monthly-label windows, NOT a strict independent out-of-sample coverage and not a guarantee

low_ratio_skus.interpretation: ratio = seasonal contrast / YoY level: the denominator is the Jul-Aug-Sep peak, the numerator is last year's Oct-Dec trough. Jun-Sep 2026 is not >10% above the same months last year (often lower), so the 8-20% is mainly seasonal, not a forecast collapse or a recent-strength story. Sep-2026 is far below Aug-2026 and current available is far below positive open SO, so censoring is plausible; the trough may itself be understated.

white_aug_peak.interpretation: The Aug-2026 peak (280) is a repeat of Aug-2025 (240, the launch month), not a single wholesale order: it is 237 Amazon unit orders (qty 1-2), plus 32 Wayfair, 5 Shopify. But only two August observations exist, one is the launch month, and Jun-2026 also spikes (141), so the peak cannot be separated from launch/promo/listing effects. mean3 extrapolates the Aug spike to 107.7/month for Oct-Dec; last year's Oct-Dec was 2/5/15 (mean 7.3). Do not use mean3 as the Q4 baseline.
white_aug_peak.recommendation: Keep Aug as an explicit event scenario, not a seasonal baseline. For Q4 use peer shape (47.2) / seasonal naive (22.0) as the low baseline and mean3 (323) only as an upper event-like scenario; need 2 more August observations or a promo/listing calendar to identify the peak.

SO/WO snapshots are 10-20/21, inventory is 10-22; the 1-2 day difference is not bridged.
